protocol.arrival_model: independent Poisson arrivals per second; common tape across budgets
protocol.dispatch: global synchronous frames; released jobs only; FIFO within class
protocol.score: queue weighted actual frame departures divided by actual frame duration
protocol.budget_unit: candidate construction or feasibility attempt; seeds included
protocol.stopping_rule: stop arrivals at horizon, then drain the same finite prefix

certificates.capacity_basis: lanes times convex hull of all admitted lane requirements/max(1,duration)

limitations: The certificate is for the deterministic cached phase model with stochastic arrivals; no new physical service confidence guarantee is inferred.
Canonical job sizes, resident phase accounting and synchronized barriers define a new experiment; this does not certify the previous asynchronous lognormal-size replay.
All-state drift uses the proved homogeneous-seed support bound. The trace maximum of the adaptive candidate gap is not substituted for a uniform theorem parameter.
Four- and eight-lane catalogue replication measures candidate construction only, not measured performance on additional hardware.
